# Cargo Department SOP These are the list of SOPs that Cargo Personnel should follow. These are, as stated before, [bold]not checklists[/bold] and should be treated as guidelines.
The following jobs have entries in this Department, the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Quartermaster[/bold][/color] being the Head of Staff and the [color=#846326]Bosun[/color] assisting in training: - [textlink="Quartermaster" link="QuartermasterSOP"] - [textlink="Bosun" link="BosunSOP"] - [textlink="Cargo Technician" link="CargoTechSOP"] - [textlink="Courier" link="CourierSOP"] - [textlink="Salvage Specialist" link="SalvageSpecialistSOP"]
